contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider. The warranty is separate from the return policy. Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.

Customers should begin with safe troubleshooting: restart the device, install supported updates, test a known-good cable or network when relevant, and record error messages. A device that is overheating, smoking, swollen, or wet should be powered down when safe and disconnected from charging. Customers must not open a sealed battery or bypass an electrical safety feature.
